2.8] To reduce the country's persistently high unemployment and to catch up to EU income levels, FYR Macedonia needs to
accelerate GDP growth through policies, regulations, and investments which enhance long-term growth prospects and job
creation. Maintaining robust economic growth via improved competitiveness has been a central concern of policymakers, in
particular when thinking ahead to the challenges of EU membership. Moreover, as an EU candidate country, the country
must balance the challenge of ensuring continued economic growth and competitiveness with fuller consideration of climate
change and environmental quality. A changing climate is already harming Macedonia's economy, and the country faces
challenges in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and increasing the use of renewable sources of energy. Complying with the
EU environmental acquis, promoting efficient use of natural resources, preserving biodiversity, and enhancing tourism

opportunities are increasingly important to furthering national development.
